dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: #Alright, {NICKNAME}, who we gonna throw down with next? I'm ready to rumble!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: What are we waiting for, anyway? C'mon, let's gooo! Or they'll start thinkin' we're scared of 'em!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh, but I guess you need some time to organize the victory feast, right? Gotta plan ahead for these things! ...Okay yeah, we can hang around here a little longer. Good thing I got this lollipop to tide me over.
